Package index

Calculating kinematic viscosity

Core ASTM D445-26 Eq 2 / D446-24 Eq 5 calculation (nu = C * t), and the full two-determination workflow that resolves calibration factors, calculates both determinations, and checks determinability in one call.

calculate_kinematic_viscosity()
Calculate kinematic viscosity from time and calibration constant.
build_sample_result()
Build a sample result record.

Viscometer registry

Add, look up, and maintain viscometers in the local SQLite registry, including archiving, use-count tracking, and in-place calibration-factor correction.

build_viscometer_record()
Build a viscometer record tibble.
validate_viscometer_record()
Validate a viscometer record.
validate_viscometer()
Validate a viscometer identifier.
format_viscometer_id()
Format a viscometer ID
add_viscometer()
Add a viscometer record to the local registry.
get_viscometer()
Get one viscometer by identifier.
list_viscometers()
List all viscometers in the local registry.
list_active_viscometers()
List active viscometers in the local registry.
list_archived_viscometers()
List archived viscometers in the local registry.
archive_viscometer()
Archive a viscometer in the local registry.
unarchive_viscometer()
Unarchive a viscometer in the local registry.
remove_viscometer()
Remove a viscometer from the local registry.
update_viscometer_factors()
Update calibration factors for an existing viscometer.
resolve_calibration_factor()
Resolve the calibration factor for a specific bulb and temperature.
increment_viscometer_use()
Increment viscometer use counters by one.
reset_viscometer_use_count()
Reset viscometer use count since deep cleaning.
get_viscometer_use_summary()
Get viscometer use counters.

Precision checks (determinability, repeatability, reproducibility)

ASTM D445-26 Section 17 precision rules and the checks that compare measured values against them.

validate_sample_type_rule()
Validate a sample-type precision rule.
get_sample_type_rule()
Get a sample-type precision rule.
add_sample_type_rule()
Add or replace a sample type precision rule.
evaluate_determinability()
Evaluate determinability for a sample at a given temperature.
evaluate_repeatability()
Evaluate repeatability between two independent results.
evaluate_reproducibility()
Evaluate reproducibility between two independent results from different labs.

Reporting and session state

Render sample and session reports, lock results once reviewed, and format numeric/label output for display.

render_primary_report()
Render a primary sample report.
render_high_density_report()
Render a high-density locked sample report.
lock_result()
Lock a result in the session state.
session_results_table()
Create a session results table.
format_significant()
Format a numeric value to at least a given number of significant figures.

Reference data storage

Save and load the local SQLite registry (viscometers and sample-type precision rules) as a whole.

save_reference_data()
Save reference data to the local database.
load_reference_data()
Load reference data from the local database.

Shiny application

Launch the interactive measurement and registry-maintenance app.

run_app()
Run the kinvicalc Shiny application.
format_sample_type_label_app()
Format a sample type code as a human-readable label.
